sources.title: Jets offensive injury report: Mason Taylor inches toward return when Jets play the Browns, Adonai Mitchell’s status looking shaky
sources.description: We are approaching an important game for the Jets in Week 5 against the Cleveland Browns. It appears the team is on the verge of getting back one of its top two tight ends. Mason Taylor, who has missed the last two games with a thumb injury, has been a full participant at both days […]
